SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.order_id) AS row_no, o.order_id, o.order_at, AS order_summary, o.total_price, AS display_status, MAX(od.store_at) AS store_at FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, o.total_price ORDER BY o.order_id
AND MAX(od.store_at) >= #{startDate} AND MAX(od.store_at) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY o.order_id
